known_gaps: The stored outgoing_damage_reduction on the mark has no runtime consumer until enemy attack execution is modeled in content; the reduction amount itself is asserted on the stored mark only.

name: Tears Beneath the Mask
tested_hypotheses: Ultimate trigger is the native DAMAGE_SOURCE_CATEGORY_Q packet classification; other known categories (A/B/E/F/H/P/R/T/X/Z) do not mark, and a missing or unrecognized classification fails the hit instead of silently skipping.

The mark applies to the hit enemy on connected hits only; zero-damage Ultimate packets mark nothing. Hit deliveries currently address only target index 0 (admission schedules HitDelivery with target_index 0), so the mark binds to target 0.
Warning Gaze is a single per-source instance (max_stacks 1, PerSource scope): re-application refreshes the 20s window via RefreshPolicy::Reset rather than stacking.

Enemy outgoing damage has no content-runtime consumer: no enemy attack execution exists in the content simulation and incoming_damage_events are unattributed scripted values. The mark is stored with its ratio and expiry; the reduction applies when enemy attack execution is modeled. Return condition: wire EnemyAttackSpec-style enemy damage through the content scheduler and multiply by (1 - reduction) as a distinct evidenced zone per the combat formula contract.
buff_NestBird_CD2 (30s, constant across tiers) has no evidenced gameplay role; it is projected into report metadata as an observed unapplied curve, not into the proc.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
